evals.prompt: Add a three-card benefits section to the home page
assertions: Reads AGENTS.md and docs/design-system.md before editing
Uses shared editorial primitives and design tokens, no hard-coded colours or media queries
Reports npm run check and the browser projects as verified or not verified

evals.prompt: Add a buy button to the new landing section
assertions: Uses CheckoutLink for the principal CTA and never a direct upsell checkout link
Keeps coral for the purchase action only

evals.prompt: Add a hero video to the page
assertions: Requires poster, playsinline, preload metadata and a text alternative
Routes media through the manifest instead of committing an original
